user.title: Connect MiniJ
user.description: Enter a session token from your signed-in MiniJ app. This integration reads appliance status. Phone/SMS login is not supported yet.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect MiniJ
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new session token from the same MiniJ account.

error.invalid_response: MiniJ did not return a valid account identity.
error.no_devices: No appliances are bound to this MiniJ account.
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different MiniJ account.

abort.already_configured: This MiniJ account is already configured.
